_doc: A 30 x 30 mm slotted aluminium profile as sold unbranded ("3030, 30x30 slot 8, B-type"): a stand-in until the bar in hand is measured (cad measure, or a caliper and cad rules draft profile). Its outline is one named seller's CAD outline (KJN), its section figures and alloy another's catalogue (Dold Mechatronik), and every figure is community. Far-East "3030" stock is close to it (corner radius 2.5, a slot 8.2 wide and 9.2 deep). The drawn outline leaves out the notches round the bore, the steps at the mouths, the V grooves and the hollows' rounded corners.
